sources.entry: Better Wacom - Per-app ExpressKeys, long-press actions and multi-mode dials for the Wacom Intuos Pro M (2025, PTK-670), running next to the official driver. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/myyccccc/Better-Wacom) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: A native macOS app that customizes the ExpressKeys and dials on the Wacom Intuos Pro M (2025, PTK-670) with per-app profiles, long-press actions and multi-mode dials, running alongside the official Wacom driver.
use_cases: remap Wacom Intuos Pro M express keys to shortcuts
different tablet layouts for Photoshop, Lightroom or Resolve
set long-press actions on tablet keys
use dials for zoom, scrolling or brush size
switch display color mode or audio output with a hold-and-turn overlay
customize a Wacom tablet on macOS without replacing the driver
how_to_run: Install the official Wacom driver (needed for the pen).
In Wacom Center, set every ExpressKey and both dials to Disabled.
Download Better-Wacom.zip from the latest release, unzip it and move Better Wacom to Applications.
Open the app and allow Accessibility and Input Monitoring in System Settings > Privacy & Security.
To build from source: git clone the repository, cd Better-Wacom, then run ./build.sh (builds a release, packs ~/Applications/Better Wacom.app and launches it).
notable: Reads the tablet with IOHIDManager without taking it over, so the official driver keeps handling pen pressure, tilt and mapping
Per-app profiles switch automatically with the front app, with a General profile filling unset keys
Each key supports a click action and a long-press action
Dials have multiple modes with acceleration; hold-to-choose overlays let you hold a key, turn a dial, and release to apply
Config is a plain JSON file that is written atomically and reloaded when changed on disk
caveats: Supports only the Wacom Intuos Pro M (2025, PTK-670); other Wacom tablets are not supported yet
Requires the official Wacom driver installed and ExpressKeys/dials disabled in Wacom Center
Requires macOS 15 Sequoia or later and Accessibility and Input Monitoring permissions
With an ad-hoc signature (building without a Developer ID certificate), macOS may ask for Accessibility permission again after each rebuild
